faqs.q: What is Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 used for?
faqs.a: Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 is the chain of an anchor cable, with a stud across each link to stiffen it and stop it kinking, joined by shackles and swivels and made to classification-society rules. It is listed in 60 sizes, 1/2″ (12.5 mm) to 6-3/8″ (162 mm).

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3, such as IH-LR-AC-SLACGU1U2-050?
faqs.a: Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 part numbers begin with IH-LR-AC-SLACGU1U2 and end in a size code: IH-LR-AC-SLACGU1U2-050 is the 1/2″ (12.5 mm) size and IH-LR-AC-SLACGU1U2-638 is the 6-3/8″ (162 mm) size. Quote the full part number from the size table, or give us the size and the load you need, when you enquire.

faqs.q: What sizes does Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 come in?
faqs.a: Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 is listed in 60 sizes, 1/2″ (12.5 mm) to 6-3/8″ (162 mm), each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-LR-AC-SLACGU1U2-050 and IH-LR-AC-SLACGU1U2-638. The table includes 1/2″ (12.5 mm): minimum breaking load (U1) 66 kN, minimum breaking load (U2) 92 kN, minimum breaking load (U3) 132 kN and 6-3/8″ (162 mm): weight per metre 610 kg.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3?
faqs.a: For Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3, the grade and diameter follow from the vessel's equipment number under its classification society rules. Specify by nominal diameter, grade (U1, U2 or U3) and the society the vessel is built to, and match accessories to the chain grade and size.

faqs.q: What are the proof and breaking loads of Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3?
faqs.a: Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 is listed with minimum breaking loads of 66–12,160 kN across its sizes, set out by grade in the size table. These are IACS UR W18 classification-society test loads, not working loads, and the anchoring equipment is sized from the vessel's equipment number under its class rules.

faqs.q: What is Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 made from, and what finish does it have?
faqs.a: Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 is made from low carbon alloy steel, welded and heat treated, with a finish of hot-dip galvanized, black bitumen coating.

faqs.q: What standard and certificates apply to Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3?
faqs.a: Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 is listed to IACS UR W18, and its proof and minimum breaking loads in the size table follow that rule. Tell us which classification society the vessel is built to, and which certificates the vessel needs; see our [anchor chain testing guide](/blog/anchor-chain-testing-proof-break-ndt) for how proof and break tests are done.

faqs.q: What does Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 connect to or work with?
faqs.a: For Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3, the chain is joined and ended with Kenter and joining shackles, end and enlarged links and swivels of the same grade; they are on the [anchor chain accessories shelf](/c/anchor-chain-accessories).

faqs.q: How should Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 be inspected and looked after?
faqs.a: Inspect Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 for wear, corrosion, stretch and damaged coating, measuring the link diameter against the original size. Our [wear limits guide](/blog/anchor-chain-wear-limits) shows how wear is assessed. Ships follow the survey regime of their classification society.

faqs.q: What is the difference between stud link and studless anchor chain?
faqs.a: Stud Link Anchor Chain, Grades U1, U2 and U3 has a stud across each link, while [Studless Anchor Chain — Grades U1, U2 and U3](/p/studless-anchor-chain-grades-u1-u2-and-u3) has none; this listing offers 60 sizes against 38 for the other. Our [stud link vs studless guide](/blog/stud-link-vs-studless-chain) explains when each is used.
